The '''Empire''' is one of the three major player-facing superpowers in ''Elite Dangerous'', alongside the Federation and the Alliance. It is an aristocratic, feudal-style government tracing its roots to Achenar, currently led by Empress Arissa Lavigny-Duval, the 16th Emperor of the Empire.<ref name="galnet-empire">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/galnet/arissa-retakes-imperial-throne Arissa Retakes the Imperial Throne], Elite Dangerous Galnet, Frontier Developments.</ref>

== Why it matters for Engineering ==

Some Engineers gate their invitation requirement behind reputation or rank with a specific superpower rather than an activity or another Engineer's referral. [[Hera Tani]] is one of these: her invitation requires reaching '''Imperial Navy rank Outsider''' or higher — the first earned rank in Empire naval progression — rather than a generic reputation score with an arbitrary faction.

Imperial Navy rank is distinct from ordinary reputation with an individual Empire-aligned minor faction; it is earned through service to the Empire itself and tracked separately.
